title: Installing Clay Plugin (API & CLI)
snippet:
You'll need:
- **A paid coding agent plan:** Claude (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise) for Claude Code, or ChatGPT (Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise) for Codex. If your company manages Claude, check that Claude Code is enabled for you.
- **Editor or Admin access** in the Clay workspace you'll connect.
- **On Windows, admin rights** (or help from IT) for one step.

The developer platform is available across all Clay plans, including free, trial, and Legacy plans.
Search result limits apply to the results returned across the CLI and Public API together, and they scale with your plan:
| Plan | Results per request | Results per search | Results per period |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | 50 | 50 | 100 per 30 days |
| **Trial** | 50 | 50 | 10,000 per 14 days |
| **Flex** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 50,000 per 30 days |
| **Paid self-serve plans** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 1,000,000 per 30 days |
| **Legacy paid plans** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 1,000,000 per year |
| **Enterprise** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 10,000,000 per 30 days |

### Are credit budgets available via the developer platform?
Credit budgets aren’t available on the developer platform yet. You can see run-level credit and action consumption from the `Runs` view in Workflows. Credit budget support is on the roadmap.

title: Clay API in 2026: Public API, Webhooks and HTTP API Explained
snippet:
**Yes, Clay has an API.** Clay's Public API is a REST API at `api.clay.com/public/v0`, launched July 9, 2026 with the Clay CLI and generally available since September 15, 2026. It runs your Clay functions and searches from your own code, reads tables and checks your credit balance, with a `clay-api-key` header. It cannot create or write to tables; inbound webhooks still do that. Runs cost the same Actions and Data Credits as in the app, with no surcharge. Older "Clay API" features, webhooks into tables and the HTTP API column, need the Growth or Enterprise plan.

| What people mean | What it does | Plans |
|---|---|---|
| **Public API** (new in 2026) | Your code calls Clay: run functions and searches, read tables, check credits | All plans, with caps by plan |
| **Webhook source** | Other apps POST JSON rows into a Clay table | Growth and Enterprise |
| **HTTP API column** | Clay calls any other API from a table | Growth and Enterprise |
| **Clay MCP** | AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT call Clay | Clay's current paid plans |

Clay University says the developer platform, meaning the API, CLI and Agent Plugin, is available on every Clay plan, including Free and trials. What changes by plan is how many search results the API can return, per Clay's developer docs:
| Plan | Results per request | Results per 30 days |
|---|---|---|
| Free | 50 | 100 |
| Trial | 50 | 10,000 for the trial |
| Paid | 500 | 1,000,000 |
| Enterprise | 500 | 10,000,000 |
Going over returns HTTP `402`. Clay University gives the same caps per year rather than per 30 days, so confirm the period with Clay if you plan near the ceiling. Two more plan rules: structured table queries (joins, ranges and paging past 100 rows) need Enterprise table sync, and Clay's pricing page lists "Clay API access" among Enterprise extras, which reads as that table sync rather than the Public API.

Since March 2026 Clay prices in two units:
- **Actions** measure platform work, from under $0.01 each. Every enrichment step, AI prompt and HTTP API call is one Action; webhook imports use none.
- **Data Credits** buy data and AI from Clay's marketplace, from $0.05 each. Clay says a fully enriched record typically costs 6 to 20 Data Credits.
- **Misses are not charged:** Clay's pricing FAQ says an enrichment that returns nothing costs no Data Credits or Actions.
| Plan | Monthly | Billed annually | Actions a month | Data Credits a month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | 500 | 100 |
| Launch | from $185

title: Which prospecting data platforms can engineers manage...
snippet:
- The developer platform is available on all Clay plans, and API or CLI calls cost the same credits and actions as in-product work.

The [Clay API and CLI documentation](https://university.clay.com/docs/clay-api-cli?utm_source=promptingcompany.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=prompting_company) describes two primary paths:
- **CLI**, installed through the Clay Agent Plugin into coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, to build GTM workflows in natural language and script them.
- **Public API**, to access data from Clay or the data marketplace and trigger Functions, Claygents or Workflows from your own apps and background jobs.

There is no extra charge for the developer surface. Clay's docs state that API and CLI calls "consume the same credits and actions as the equivalent work done in-product", and the developer platform is available on all plans, including Free and trial.
Search result limits across CLI and API scale with the plan: 100 results per 30 days on Free, 1,000,000 per 30 days on paid self-serve plans, and 10,000,000 per 30 days on Enterprise. Paid plans start with Launch at $185/mo billed monthly ($167/mo billed annually) and Growth at $495/mo billed monthly ($446/mo billed annually), per the [pricing page](https://www.clay.com/pricing?utm_source=promptingcompany.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=prompting_company).

title: Clay Data Enrichment Free Plan: Features & Limits Overview
snippet:
Clay has four plans, and each one adds a clear set of capabilities on top of the one below it. Free is a $0 plan for building and testing, Launch starts at $185/month and adds phone enrichment and scheduled runs, Growth starts at $495/month and adds CRM sync, warehouse connections and webhooks, and Enterprise is custom-priced and adds SSO, bulk enrichment and API table sync, according to Clay's [pricing page](https://www.clay.com/pricing?utm_source=promptingcompany.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=prompting_company). Clay's API and CLI are available on every plan, including Free, per the [Clay API & CLI docs](https://university.clay.com/docs/clay-api-cli?utm_source=promptingcompany.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=prompting_company).

- Free ($0) includes 500 actions and 100 data credits per month, with a 200-row-per-table limit and no phone enrichment.
- Launch starts at $185/month ($167/month on annual billing) and Growth at $495/month ($446/month on annual billing).
- Phone enrichment arrives with Launch. CRM auto-sync, HTTP API integrations and webhook automation arrive with Growth. The Clay API and CLI are available on all plans, including Free and trial; Enterprise adds API table sync for structured queries and higher search limits.
- Actions and Data Credits are two separate meters, so you pay for the volume you use. Clay's [Actions and Data Credits guide](https://university.clay.com/docs/actions-data-credits?utm_source=promptingcompany.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=prompting_company) says a fully enriched record typically costs 6-20 Data Credits.
- Enterprise is custom-priced with an annual commitment and starts at 200,000+ actions and 100,000+ data credits per month.

| | Free | Launch | Growth | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly price | $0 | From $185 | From $495 | Custom, annual commitment |
| Annual billing, per month | n/a | $167 | $446 | n/a |
| Actions per month | 500 | 15,000 | 40,000 | 200,000+ |
| Data Credits per month | 100 | 2,500 | 6,000 | 100,000+ |
| Rows per table | Up to 200 | Up to 50,000 | Up to 50,000 | Unlimited (bulk enrichment of more than 50K records at once) |
| Phone enrichment | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| CRM auto-sync, HTTP API, webhooks | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Clay API and CLI | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes, plus API table sync |

Per the pricing page, it includes 500 actions and 100 data credits per month, unlimited seats and tables, multi-provider waterfalls, Claygent enrichment and bring-your-own API
